#include<cstdio>
#include<cstring>

#define N 100010
using namespace std;
typedef int typ;
#define M 1000010
#define inf 1000000000
#define winf 1000000000

struct Edge {
    int nxt, to, f;
    typ w;
} e[M<<1];
int head[N], cnt = 1, tot;

void addEdge(int u, int v, int f, typ w) {
    e[++cnt] = {head[u], v, f, w};
    head[u] = cnt;
    e[++cnt] = {head[v], u, 0, -w};
    head[v] = cnt;
}

namespace MCMF {
    int cur[N];
    bool vis[N];
    struct Node {
        int u;
        typ d;
        Node(int U = 0, typ D = 0) : u(U), d(D) {}
        bool operator<(const Node &a) const { return d > a.d; }
    };
    priority_queue<Node> pq;
    typ dist[N], pot[N];

    bool dijkstra(int s, int t) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= tot; ++i) dist[i] = winf, cur[i] = head[i];
        dist[t] = 0;
        pq.push(Node(t, 0));
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            int u = pq.top().u;
            pq.pop();
            if (vis[u]) continue;
            vis[u] = true;
            for (int i = head[u]; i; i = e[i].nxt) {
                int v = e[i].to;
                typ w = pot[u] + e[i^1].w - pot[v];
                if (e[i^1].f && dist[u] + w < dist[v]) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + w;
                    pq.push(Node(v, dist[v]));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= tot; ++i) pot[i] = min(pot[i] + dist[i], winf);
        if (!vis[s]) return false;
        for (int i = 1; i <= tot; ++i) vis[i] = false;
        return true;
    }

        if (u == t || !fl) return fl;
        int res = 0;
        vis[u] = true;
        for (int &i = cur[u]; i; i = e[i].nxt) {
            if (e[i].f) {
                int v = e[i].to, f;
                if (!vis[v] && pot[v] + e[i].w == pot[u] && (f = dfs(v, t, min(fl, e[i].f)))) {
                    e[i].f -= f;
                    e[i^1].f += f;
                    res += f;
                    fl -= f;
                    if (!fl) break;
                }
            }
        }
        vis[u] = false;
        return res;
    }

    int maxFlow;
    typ minCost;
    void solve(int s, int t) {
        while (dijkstra(s, t)) {
            int w = dfs(s, t, inf);
            maxFlow += w;
            minCost += w * pot[s];
        }
    }
}

vector<int> adj[N];

inline int id(int t, int x) { return t * n + x + 2; }

    tot += n;

        adj[v].push_back(u);
